reuse.why: Uses the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend (with frequency, so the daily-skip rule comes from the helper), recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule, but repeats the outer skipWeekend ternary rather than sharing it with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The 'config.skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date' wrapper and the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffolding mirror getUpcomingDates; the weekend rule itself is not duplicated.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, readable, with a named shift-window constant; the only weak point is the enable-flag check repeated at each caller of the helper.
